title: Identifying an Ellipsoid and Finding its Principal Trace
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Identify the quadric surface x^2/4 + y^2/9 + z^2/16 = 1 and find the area of its trace in the xy-plane.

steps.title: Classify Quadric Surface
steps.explanation: All three variables are squared with positive coefficients summing to 1, defining an ellipsoid with semi-axes a = 2, b = 3, c = 4.

steps.title: Find xy-Trace and Compute Area
steps.explanation: Set z = 0 to get an ellipse with semi-axes 2 and 3; its area is pi*a*b.
